-- FlyGui LocalScript
-- Put this in: StarterPlayer > StarterPlayerScripts (as a LocalScript)

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera

-- Settings
local flySpeed = 50
local MIN_SPEED, MAX_SPEED = 1, 1000
local flying = false
local flyConnection
local bodyVelocity, bodyGyro

-- ========== GUI ==========
local screenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
screenGui.Name = "FlyGui"
screenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
screenGui.Parent = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

local mainFrame = Instance.new("Frame")

Instance.new("UICorner", flyBtn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)

-- ========== FLY LOGIC ==========
local function getCharacterParts()
	local char = player.Character
	if not char then return end
	local root = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	return char, root, hum
end

local function stopFly()
	flying = false
	if flyConnection then
		flyConnection:Disconnect()
		flyConnection = nil
	end
	if bodyVelocity then bodyVelocity:Destroy() bodyVelocity = nil end
	if bodyGyro then bodyGyro:Destroy() bodyGyro = nil end

	local _, _, hum = getCharacterParts()
	if hum then hum.PlatformStand = false end

	flyBtn.Text = "Fly: OFF"
	flyBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 60, 60)
end

local function startFly()
	local _, root, hum = getCharacterParts()
	if not root or not hum then return end

	flying = true
	hum.PlatformStand = true

	bodyVelocity = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
	bodyVelocity.MaxForce = Vector3.new(1e9, 1e9, 1e9)
	bodyVelocity.Velocity = Vector3.zero
	bodyVelocity.Parent = root

	bodyGyro = Instance.new("BodyGyro")
	bodyGyro.MaxTorque = Vector3.new(1e9, 1e9, 1e9)
	bodyGyro.P = 9e4
	bodyGyro.CFrame = camera.CFrame
	bodyGyro.Parent = root

	flyBtn.Text = "Fly: ON"
	flyBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(60, 180, 90)

	flyConnection = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
		local _, r, h = getCharacterParts()
		if not r or not h or not bodyVelocity then
			stopFly()
			return
		end

		camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
		local camCF = camera.CFrame
		local direction = Vector3.zero

		-- WASD / mobile thumbstick (relative to where the camera looks)
		local moveDir = h.MoveDirection
		if moveDir.Magnitude > 0 then
			local flatLook = Vector3.new(camCF.LookVector.X, 0, camCF.LookVector.Z)
			local flatRight = Vector3.new(camCF.RightVector.X, 0, camCF.RightVector.Z)
			if flatLook.Magnitude > 0.001 then flatLook = flatLook.Unit end
			if flatRight.Magnitude > 0.001 then flatRight = flatRight.Unit end
			local forwardAmt = moveDir:Dot(flatLook)
			local rightAmt = moveDir:Dot(flatRight)
			direction = camCF.LookVector * forwardAmt + camCF.RightVector * rightAmt
		end

		-- Up / down (only when not typing in a textbox)
		if not UserInputService:GetFocusedTextBox() then
			if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Space) then
				direction += Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
			end
			if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl)
				or UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift) then
				direction -= Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
			end
		end

		if direction.Magnitude > 0 then
			direction = direction.Unit
		end

		bodyVelocity.Velocity = direction * flySpeed
		bodyGyro.CFrame = camCF
	end)
end

local function toggleFly()
	if flying then
		stopFly()
	else
		startFly()
	end
end

-- ========== BUTTON EVENTS ==========
flyBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(toggleFly)

speedBox.FocusLost:Connect(function()
	local value = tonumber(speedBox.Text)
	if value then
		flySpeed = math.clamp(value, MIN_SPEED, MAX_SPEED)
	end
	speedBox.Text = tostring(flySpeed) -- reset invalid input to the current speed
end)

local minimized = false
minBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	minimized = not minimized
	content.Visible = not minimized
	mainFrame.Size = minimized and UDim2.new(0, 260, 0, 30) or UDim2.new(0, 260, 0, 150)
	minBtn.Text = minimized and "+" or "-"
end)

closeBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	stopFly()
	screenGui:Destroy()
end)

-- Turn fly off if the character respawns
player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
	if flying then stopFly() end
end)

-- ========== DRAGGING ==========
local dragging, dragStart, startPos

titleBar.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
		or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
		dragging = true
		dragStart = input.Position
		startPos = mainFrame.Position
		input.Changed:Connect(function()
			if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
				dragging = false
			end
		end)
	end
end)

UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
	if dragging and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
		or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
		local delta = input.Position - dragStart
		mainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(
			startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + delta.X,
			startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y
		)
	end
end)

task.spawn(function()

	while gui.Parent do

		task.wait(0.01)

		if enabled and not busy then

			local character, root = getCharacter()

			if character and root then

				busy = true

				local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera

				-- Save camera position before teleport
				local savedCameraCFrame

				if stableCamera and camera then
					savedCameraCFrame = camera.CFrame
				end

				-- Save player position
				local returnCFrame = root.CFrame

				VOID_DISTANCE = distanceSlider:Get()
				VOID_TIME = voidTimeSlider:Get()
				RETURN_TIME = returnTimeSlider:Get()

				-- Teleport downward
				root.CFrame =
					returnCFrame *
					CFrame.new(0, -VOID_DISTANCE, 0)

				-- Keep camera visually stable
				if stableCamera and camera and savedCameraCFrame then

					local endTime =
						os.clock() + VOID_TIME

					while os.clock() < endTime do

						if camera and camera.Parent then
							camera.CFrame = savedCameraCFrame
						end

						task.wait()
					end

				else
					task.wait(VOID_TIME)
				end

				-- Return player
				if root and root.Parent then
					root.CFrame = returnCFrame
				end

				-- Restore camera again
				if stableCamera and camera and savedCameraCFrame then
					camera.CFrame = savedCameraCFrame
				end

				task.wait(RETURN_TIME)

				busy = false
			end
		end
	end
end)

scripts.title: Rimuru's Loop Tp Script
scripts.features:
• Save a position for you to tp
• Also can Loop the save tp
• Rimuru theme
scripts.script:
-- Services
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local CoreGui = game:GetService("CoreGui")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local player = Players.LocalPlayer

-- Prevent duplicate UI instances on re-execute
if getgenv().TeleportUI then
    getgenv().TeleportUI:Destroy()
end

-- Create Main ScreenGui
local screenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
screenGui.Name = "RimuruHubUI"
screenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
getgenv().TeleportUI = screenGui

local parentTarget = (syn and syn.protect_gui and CoreGui) or (gethui and gethui()) or CoreGui or player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
screenGui.Parent = parentTarget

----------------------------------------------------
-- GAMBAR RIMURU TEMPEST
----------------------------------------------------
local RIMURU_IMAGE_ID = "rbxassetid://77509198141449" -- Decal ID

----------------------------------------------------
-- FLOATING TOGGLE BUTTON (DELTA STYLE)
----------------------------------------------------
local toggleBtn = Instance.new("ImageButton")
toggleBtn.Name = "DeltaToggleButton"
toggleBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0) -- Start size 0 for pop-in animation
toggleBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0, 20, 0.5, -25)
toggleBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(10, 25, 45) -- Rimuru Deep Blue
toggleBtn.Image = RIMURU_IMAGE_ID
toggleBtn.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Crop
toggleBtn.Active = true
toggleBtn.Visible = false
toggleBtn.Parent = screenGui

local toggleCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
toggleCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
toggleCorner.Parent = toggleBtn

local toggleStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
toggleStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(0, 195, 255)
toggleStroke.Thickness = 2
toggleStroke.Parent = toggleBtn

-- Dragging Logic for Floating Button
local dragging, dragInput, dragStart, startPos
local function updateDrag(input)
    local delta = input.Position - dragStart
    toggleBtn.Position = UDim2.new(startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + delta.X, startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y)
end

toggleBtn.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        dragging = true
        dragStart = input.Position
        startPos = toggleBtn.Position
        input.Changed:Connect(function()
            if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
                dragging = false
            end
        end)
    end
end)

toggleBtn.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        dragInput = input
    end
end)

UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if input == dragInput and dragging then
        updateDrag(input)
    end
end)

----------------------------------------------------
-- FULLSCREEN LOADING SCREEN
----------------------------------------------------
local loadingFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
loadingFrame.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0) -- Fullscreen
loadingFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
loadingFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(11, 22, 38) -- Slime Dark Blue
loadingFrame.BorderSizePixel = 0
loadingFrame.Active = true
loadingFrame.ClipsDescendants = true
loadingFrame.ZIndex = 100
loadingFrame.Parent = screenGui

local loadBgImg = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
loadBgImg.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
loadBgImg.BackgroundTransparency = 1
loadBgImg.Image = RIMURU_IMAGE_ID
loadBgImg.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Crop
loadBgImg.ImageTransparency = 0.5
loadBgImg.ZIndex = 101
loadBgImg.Parent = loadingFrame

local loadDarkOverlay = Instance.new("Frame")
loadDarkOverlay.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
loadDarkOverlay.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(8, 25, 48) -- Rimuru Blue Tint Overlay
loadDarkOverlay.BackgroundTransparency = 0.35
loadDarkOverlay.BorderSizePixel = 0
loadDarkOverlay.ZIndex = 102
loadDarkOverlay.Parent = loadingFrame

-- Center Container for Fullscreen Elements
local loadCenterFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
loadCenterFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 360, 0, 200)
loadCenterFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -180, 0.5, -100)
loadCenterFrame.BackgroundTransparency = 1
loadCenterFrame.ZIndex = 103
loadCenterFrame.Parent = loadingFrame

local avatarImg = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
avatarImg.Size = UDim2.new(0, 70, 0, 70)
avatarImg.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -35, 0, 0)
avatarImg.BackgroundTransparency = 1
avatarImg.Image = "rbxthumb://type=AvatarHeadShot&id=" .. player.UserId .. "&w=150&h=150"
avatarImg.ZIndex = 104
avatarImg.Parent = loadCenterFrame

local avatarCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
avatarCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
avatarCorner.Parent = avatarImg

local avatarStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
avatarStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(0, 195, 255)
avatarStroke.Thickness = 2
avatarStroke.Parent = avatarImg

local nameLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
nameLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 24)
nameLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0.45, 0)
nameLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
nameLabel.Text = "@" .. player.Name .. " • Rimuru Hub"
nameLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(220, 245, 255)
nameLabel.TextSize = 15
nameLabel.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
nameLabel.ZIndex = 104
nameLabel.Parent = loadCenterFrame

local loadStatus = Instance.new("TextLabel")
loadStatus.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 20)

local function performSafeTeleport()
    local targetCFrame = getgenv().TeleportSavedCFrame
    if not targetCFrame then return false end
    
    local hrp = getHRP()
    if not hrp then return false end

    hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
    hrp.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero

    local currentPos = hrp.Position
    local targetPos = targetCFrame.Position
    local distance = (targetPos - currentPos).Magnitude

    if distance > STEP_DISTANCE then
        local steps = math.ceil(distance / STEP_DISTANCE)
        for i = 1, steps do
            if not hrp or not hrp.Parent then break end
            local alpha = i / steps
            hrp.CFrame = currentPos:Lerp(targetPos, alpha) * targetCFrame.Rotation
            hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
            task.wait()
        end
    else
        hrp.CFrame = targetCFrame
    end

    hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
    return true
end
